messages:
sophia: AM async standup — quick sync on roadmap & launch prep.

sophia: What I did: finished API compatibility table for v2 routing and pushed the spec updates in /docs/route-v2.md. Blockers: waiting on final SLA wording from Legal for Dedicated. Today: address PR feedback + prep canary smoke tests.

raj: Got it. I'll re-run perf numbers for the quantized 4-bit profiles and update the slides by EOD. Quick question — for fallback model do we prefer redwood-std-1b or gpt-small? @sophia

sophia: let's default to redwood-std-1b for quality parity; only fall back to gpt-small if latency budget is breached. I'll add a note in the spec.

chris: CR ping — PR #482 (continuous batching + KV cache tweaks) is waiting for review. @maya can you take a look? small change: default batch_size -> 32 in config.

maya: On my list after a 10:30 meeting, will review. FYI I hit a mismatch in the embedding cache tests; filed issue #867 with logs.

olga: Legal will review SLA text offline, ETA 15:00. Also decision needed on canary scope: single-region (us-west-2) or multi-region? I recommend single-region initial canary.

raj: Single-region + automatic fallback to other region on failure sounds good. I'll add a routing_policy flag to the deployment config and push a patch.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary window scheduled tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Ensure PRs merged and smoke tests are green.

sophia: noted. Who's owning the rollout runbook? @chris?

chris: I can own it. I'll draft the steps, rollback playbook, and a latency/cost scoreboard. Draft by 11:30.

maya: I'll add QA steps for embedding cache and assemble a focused prompt set for smoke tests.

olga: +1 single-region. Legal will sign off after SLA tweak. Also flagging finance review if we add any promo pricing for early customers.

sophia: Action items: chris -> runbook; raj -> routing flag + patch; maya -> CR + QA prompt set; olga -> SLA text + region decision; me -> consolidate checklist and post in #eng-releases. If you're blocked, reply here. :thumbsup:

raj: noted, will follow up on the PR link when patched.

maya: reviewing PR now, will comment inline. :mag:

chris: adding runbook stub in /docs/runbooks/redwood-v2-canary.md; sharing link shortly.

sophia: thanks everyone — I'll post the checklist and owners in #eng-releases in 30m.
